problem.passage:
A cylindrical water tank has a radius of 3 feet and a height of 10 feet.

What is the volume of the tank, in cubic feet, in terms of $\pi$? (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ as your answer, i.e., the value $V$ such that the volume is $V\pi$ cubic feet.)
problem.stimulus: A cylindrical water tank has a radius of 3 feet and a height of 10 feet.
problem.question: What is the volume of the tank, in cubic feet, in terms of $\pi$? (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ as your answer, i.e., the value $V$ such that the volume is $V\pi$ cubic feet.)
problem.explanation: 원기둥의 부피 공식은 $V = \pi r^2 h$ 이다. 반지름 $r = 3$, 높이 $h = 10$ 을 대입하면 $V = \pi (3)^2 (10) = 90\pi$ 세제곱피트이다. 따라서 $\pi$ 의 계수는 90이다.
problem.explanationEn: The volume of a cylinder is $V = \pi r^2 h$. Substituting the radius $r = 3$ and height $h = 10$ gives $V = \pi (3)^2 (10) = 90\pi$ cubic feet. So the coefficient of $\pi$ is 90.

difficultyReasons: 원기둥 부피 공식 V=πr^2h에 값을 대입하는 단 1단계 계산
